message: 今天的讲座真的绝绝子，教授yyds！
gold_meaning: Today's lecture was absolutely amazing; the professor is the best / the GOAT.
notes: Two praise slang terms (绝绝子, yyds) → expect 'GOAT', 'slayed', 'insane'.

message: 我真的会谢，ddl前一晚电脑崩了，直接破防了😭
gold_meaning: Wow, thanks a lot (sarcastic) — my laptop crashed the night before the deadline and I completely broke down.
notes: Sarcasm (我真的会谢) is the trap: a literal tool outputs 'I will really thank'.

message: 哈哈哈xswl 你昨天那个视频简直社死现场
gold_meaning: LMAO, your video yesterday was a total moment of public embarrassment (social death).

message: 这学期太卷了，我决定躺平了
gold_meaning: This semester is way too competitive; I've decided to stop trying so hard / opt out.
notes: 内卷 and 躺平 are cultural concepts; English has no perfect slang match.

message: u1s1 这家火锅真的不错，下次一起？
gold_meaning: To be honest, this hotpot place is really good — want to go together next time?

message: 绷不住了，他说他是i人结果在KTV唱了三个小时
gold_meaning: I can't — he said he's an introvert and then sang at karaoke for three hours.

context:
A: 我刚面试完
B: 怎么样？
gold_meaning: It's over / I'm cooked (the interview went badly).
notes: Only understandable with context: tests the conversation-context field.

gold_meaning: LMAO you're insane (in a good way) / that was so skilled.
Wow, great job (sarcastic) — you're late again.
notes: Sarcasm without any slang word: tone must be preserved.

message: No cap, that party was lowkey fire 🔥 we should link up again fr
gold_meaning: Honestly, that party was really great; we should meet up again, for real.
notes: Expect 不骗你 / 真的绝了 / 再约.

message: I'm dead 💀 he really ghosted her after the first date
gold_meaning: That's hilarious — he stopped replying to her entirely after the first date.
notes: Expect 笑死 + 人间蒸发 / 已读不回.

message: Bro the exam was mid, I'm not stressing it
gold_meaning: Dude, the exam was average/meh; I'm not worried about it.

message: Wesh, t'es chaud ce soir ? On se fait un grec, c'est moi qui régale
gold_meaning: Hey, are you up for it tonight? Let's grab a kebab — it's on me.
notes: 'chaud' here = up for it, not 'hot'; 'régaler' = to pay.

message: J'suis en PLS, j'ai raté mon partiel, askip la moyenne est à 8
gold_meaning: I'm a wreck — I failed my exam; apparently the class average is 8 (out of 20).
notes: PLS, askip; '8' implies the French /20 grading scale.

message: Mdr il a trop le seum parce qu'on l'a pas invité 😂
gold_meaning: LOL he's so bitter/upset because we didn't invite him.
notes: Expect 笑死 + 酸了 / 气死了.

message: 教授，作业我明天交可以吗？这周ddl太多了，有点裂开
gold_meaning: Professor, could I hand in the assignment tomorrow? I have too many deadlines this week and I'm a bit overwhelmed.
notes: Relationship = professor: slang should be softened, not mirrored.
